title: What If Every Sea Turtle Vanished?

scenes.text: What if every sea turtle vanished? The first thing to change would be the seagrass.
Green turtles graze seagrass near the base of the blades, which keeps the beds healthy.
Without grazing, seagrass can overgrow, block currents, and rot.
Leatherbacks eat hundreds of pounds of jellyfish a day. Without them, jellyfish could multiply and eat more fish eggs.
Hawksbills eat sponges that crowd out corals, so reefs would lose a helper too.
Even beaches would change. Nesting females bring in nutrients from far away, and old eggs and shells feed dune plants.
